dimensions.evidence_accuracy: Dated facts, numerical comparisons, fiscal/share basis and citations are correct.
dimensions.analytical_depth: Explains competing causal mechanisms, interprets calculations and tests important assumptions.
dimensions.decision_usefulness: Answers the role question with differentiated implications and observable change conditions.
dimensions.uncertainty: Scopes missingness and counter-cases honestly without hiding supported conclusions or forcing preference.
dimensions.coherence: Conclusions follow the cited evidence and calculations; structured claims match the prose.

scale.3: Strong, specific and supported; only minor improvements

role_rubric.critical_gate: Any unresolved material error fails regardless of points.
role_rubric.qualification: Provisional development quality, not human acceptance, release acceptance or investment performance.

review_policy: Assistant development review is provisional. Human usefulness acceptance and investment performance are separate.
